name: Istana di Malaysia — Palaces in Malaysia
title: Istana di Malaysia — Palaces in Malaysia
description: Istana (royal palaces) across Malaysia — including the federal Istana Negara (both Jalan Tuanku Abdul Halim and the former Jalan Istana), state istana of the nine Malay rulers (Istana Alam Shah / Selangor, Istana Abu Bakar / Pahang, Istana Arau / Perlis, Istana Bukit Serene / Johor, Istana Besar Seri Menanti / Negeri Sembilan, Istana Balai Besar / Kelantan, Istana Maziah and Istana Syarqiyyah / Terengganu, Istana Mestika / Pahang), Sarawak's Astana, and historic royal residences such as Istana Bandar, Istana Mahkota, Istana Pasir Pelangi, Istana Telipot, Istana Tengku Long, Istana Satu, and Istana Melawati (Putrajaya). Sourced from ms.wikipedia Kategori:Istana_di_Malaysia (26 ns=0 articles; 4 per-state subcategories — Kedah, Perak, Terengganu, Johor — reserved for future per-state datasets); enriched with Wikidata labels, descriptions, coordinates, inception years, admin region (P131), instance-of (P31), part-of (P361), heritage status (P1435), architects (P84), architectural styles (P149), operators (P137), owners (P127), images (P18), and Wikipedia sitelinks across 33 languages.
